searchText: Hi all, question about the current state of the slashing penalities for consolidated validators. What is the current status of this portion of the spec and is there any material (posts, docs, etc.) that outline the context of it? Referencing this comment here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3618#discussion_r1522780297 cc: <@1035747431461167125> I have replied here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3618#discussion_r1522780297
